protocol.data: Same loaders/data/source and all targets as previous static tests; A123/Mendeley25C DST/FUDS/US06; Panasonic/CALCE all previous same- and cross-temperature targets. Temperature secondary only. CALCE also evaluate corrected-z0 variants from step3, mark original versus corrected clearly; V7m keeps source-fitted z0 for all targets.
protocol.model: V7m same2RC/Q/z0 with OCV monotonic piecewise cubic PCHIP on11equally spaced nodes over source SOC support. Voltages v_k=v0+cumsum(softplus(increment_raw_k)), k1..10. Positive increments, no target-voltage use.
protocol.support: For each candidate Q/z0 compute min/max causal SOC on full source; use those endpoints for node grid and constant boundary hold outside. At target evaluation support fixed from fitted source only, not expanded using target SOC.
protocol.optimizer: TRF linear least squares, x_scalejac, max_nfev500, ftol/xtol/gtol1e-8. Same3RC/Q/z0starts aslfp_static_protocol.json; initialize11OCVnode values from fixed low-current/checkpoint curve, isotonic regression then increments floored1e-5 and inverse softplus. Select smallest source SSE among converged starts.
protocol.branch_labels: Both taus bounded; sort branches fast/slow on reporting.
protocol.criterion: For each cell/dataset originally POSITIVE at same temperature, robustness iff V7m reduces MAE>=25% against original staticV1 on EVERY primary same-temperature target. A123 originalV1 refit tau<=3600. No best-of-other-model escape. Historical verdict unchanged.
protocol.calce_reporting: Historical criterion using original V1 fallback AND corrected comparison using step3V1; corrected version is principal, both reported. Physical V7m target z0 stays fitted source. Do not mix corrected baseline with old label without disclosure.
protocol.metrics: Same continuous globalMAE/RMSE/max/P99 and SOC/reversal scopes; original/corrected baseline-SOC masks identified. Relative gains signed, no clipping.
protocol.outputs: results/static_monotone, complete manifest, source fits/attempts/bound hits, monotonic OCVnode/support plots, voltage/error figures, tablesCSV/TEX, report
